method: Non-blind qualitative diagnostic comparison of selected saved output text with already reviewed source frames and frozen rubrics. Not independent human validation.

observations.observation: Delivered answers incorrectly describe four numbered steps, counting FAIL -> RETRY as step 4. The reference image has three numbered main steps; retry is an outcome branch. All three answering-model self-audits still mark the claim supported. Temporal success alone is therefore not content correctness.

Delivered answers assert an exact delegated total of 102,000; the frozen negative-control rubric says the all-subagent total is not given. Self-audit accepts these assertions. This is a content failure distinct from response-format or infrastructure errors.

Rejected finalizer drafts contain both requested limits (five sources and 500 words), but cite fewer observation windows than the runtime requires. Content similarity does not repair the saved status=error or establish complete supporting citations. These outputs remain failures in the archived denominator.

The rejected draft names Article to Curated Knowledge followed by Two Loops, One Knowledge Workflow, matching the frozen title/order rubric text. It only cites E001 and is rejected by the every-window validator. Do not retroactively turn this draft into a successful saved answer.

Delivered prose states that the exact dollar cost is not visible/shown, while the structured status is answered. The strict negative-control evaluator records failure because the abstention status was not used. This should not be described as an invented dollar-cost answer; status compliance and semantic abstention are distinct.

limits: These are selected explanatory examples, not exhaustive adjudication of 34 delivered answers.
No review files were filled and no archived quality metrics were recomputed.
